notes.title: 1.1 Released! - Big Update!
notes.content:
[h1]The latest version of VR Baseball is available NOW![/h1]

The game has been rebuilt with [b]new graphics[/b], a much larger stadium, and even a [b]new[/b] game [b]mode[/b]!

Leaderboards are in, achievements were expanded, and it's been filled with lots of extra [b]FUN[/b]!

Hop in and [b]play today[/b]!

notes.title: 1.1 Beta Available Now
notes.content:
Today I'm happy to announce [b]VR Baseball 1.1 Beta[/b] is available.  This is a big update with many changes!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Art & Stadium
[*]Leaderboards
[*]Doubled the # of Achievements
[*]Updated Sound Effects
[*][b]Golf Mode[/b]
[*]Post Round Stats
[*]More Fireworks
[*]Difficulty Adjustments (Pro is harder, Easy is easier)
[/list]

To try it out, just switch to the beta branch.
